item.title: John Mayer's first-ever India concert set for February 11 in Mumbai
item.description: John Mayer, one of contemporary music’s most influential artists, will bring his wide-ranging musical style to India for the first time with a live concert in Mumbai on February 11.

item.title: Korean game obsession turns tragic: 3 Ghaziabad teenagers jump off building, say 'sorry papa' in suicide note
item.description: Initial investigations indicate the girls had been spending significant time on mobile phones and were suspected to be addicted to a task-based Korean gaming app.

item.title: 'Dhindhora 2', 'Operation Safed Sagar', 'Family Business': Netflix's India slate for 2026 out! Movies, series to watch out
item.description: Marking a decade in India, Netflix bets big on marquee stars, fresh stories and returning fan favourites as it prepares for its largest content year yet.

item.title: 'Painful times in my marriage': Melinda Gates on Epstein files, STD claim tied to Bill Gates
item.description: Fresh disclosures linked to Jeffrey Epstein have reopened what Melinda French Gates describes as one of the most painful chapters of her marriage.

item.title: 'I want you back': Deepinder Goyal requests ex-Zomato employees to rejoin company, here's why
item.description: In this message, Goyal urged the ex-Zomato employees to rejoin the company, adding that the company has evolved.

item.title: Explained: Why Anthropic’s new AI tool is spooking India’s IT services industry
item.description: For investors, the concern is simple, tools like these could reduce the need for large teams doing repetitive or process-driven work.

item.title: Trent shares rise ahead of Q3 results; what to expect from Zudio, Westside operator
item.description: Trent share price: Antique Stock Broking expects Trent to report 21.7 per cent YoY rise in net profit at Rs 571.10 crore compared with Rs 469.30 crore in the same quarter last year.

item.title: Varun Beverages share price: VBL targets by 6 brokerages
item.description: ICICI Securities said VBL reported better-than-expected India volume growth at 10.5 per cent YoY in a seasonally weak Q4. It said a decline in realisation indicates increasing competitive intensity.
